tools.name: find
tools.description: Find the capability for a need described in plain words, English or Chinese, among 214 on 17 platforms: up to 5, best first, each with what it needs, its price and a ready call. With a platform and no match it lists everything that platform has; never use another platform's capability in its place.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: The contract of 1 to 5 capabilities: each parameter with its meaning and an example, the links url takes, price and the most one call can cost, paging, the fields returned, what the platform cannot give, an example call and an example item with its size. Free, no key. Use it when unsure of a paramet

tools.name: call
tools.description: One page from one capability, charged per call or per item returned; failed calls are free. Give the capability and only the parameters describe lists for it. The first lines of the answer give the items, the charge, the balance, the result ID and how to go on: cursor for the next page (a new charge

tools.name: read_more
tools.description: The rest of an answer call cut to fit, or the whole result in another view or with other fields. Free: nothing is fetched again. Results are kept 24 hours and read with the key's account that made the call.

tools.name: account
tools.description: balance: the balance, the key's spending limits and what it spent. receipt: what one call was charged (request_id). usage: calls and charges by day, capability, key_id, entry, source or end_user (since, until, group_by). status: which capabilities are up, no key needed. Free.
